annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2020/366 of 17 December 2019 amending Annex IV to Directive 2011/65/EU as regards an exemption for lead as a thermal stabiliser in PVC used in certain in-vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2020/366 of 17 December 2019 amending Annex IV to Directive 2011/65/EU as regards an exemption for lead as a thermal stabiliser in PVC used in certain in-vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Delegated Directive renewing, for two years, the RoHS exemption allowing lead as a thermal stabiliser in PVC sensors of certain in-vitro diagnostic blood analysers, citing lack of reliable substitutes and avoided waste. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces entry 41 of Annex IV to RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU
Exemption for lead in PVC electrochemical sensors in IVD devices renewed until 31 March 2022
Member States must transpose by 31 March 2021 and apply from 1 April 2021
Rationale: no reliable substitutes yet; discontinuation would generate 112,000 kg of premature WEEE
Aligned with REACH lead-in-PVC restriction process
